notes.content:

This latest hotfix will mean that Voidwrought is now updated to Build 1.1.33.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2014550/Voidwrought/

We’ve included the following bug fixes in this hotfix:
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where players would get stuck when quitting out of the Shrine cutscene.
[*] Fixed the issue where HP from other runs wouldn’t transfer over to NG+ Undone save.
[/list]
Thank you so much once again to everyone who has helped us by providing their feedback and bug reports!

If you do encounter any other bugs or would like to give feedback on your experience of Voidwrought so far, we’d love to hear from you either in our Steam Forum or on Discord.

[h3]Who needs cherry blossoms and butterflies when you can talk with sentient carnivorous plants and fight off mutated insects instead?

In short, spring has sprung in The Gray City and Voidwrought is now 40% off as part of the Spring Sale 🌸[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899313/c34075c9479813bd823a038bdd6f39d62831a28f.png[/img]

Voidwrought is a 2D action-platformer set in a hand-drawn world of cosmic horrors. You take on the role of the Simulacrum, a mysterious creature who has emerged from a cocoon with an unstoppable compulsion to collect Ichor, the blood of the gods. 

As you navigate your way through the ruined underground world of the First Civilization, you’ll come across hidden relics and artifacts that you can use to unlock untold powers. You will need these to fight off the inhabitants of The Gray City, who have become twisted beyond recognition by the corruption that seeps through every hall and passageway. Take on the Old Gods, rend their corpses in twain, and syphon their sacred Ichor to achieve your true potential.

The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/46079/Steam__Ichor/][b]Steam & Ichor Bundle[/b][/url] with the pixel powerhouse Gestalt: Steam & Cinder.[/h3]

notes.title: New Game+ and Hardcore Mode Unleashed
notes.content:
[h3]Are you exterminating the Heralds and Progenitors with ease? Looking for more of a challenge on your cosmic horror adventures?

Then look no further![/h3]

We’re thrilled to announce that we’ve added New Game+ and Hard Mode to Voidwrought for all of you skilled Simulacrums.

We’ve added not one, not two, but three New Game+ paths for you to enjoy!

Once you complete the main game, you’ll unlock all of the New Game+ paths. After defeating [spoiler]the Weeper[/spoiler], a New Game Plus Unlocked Message will appear on the screen to let you know that all of the paths have been unlocked.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899313/cfb785abbe84923f6ff6adc0e5d8575384db6bf4.png[/img]

From there, you’ll need to go back to the main menu and then you’ll have the option to convert an eligible save file into a New Game+ profile. Your main path progression will reset, but you will retain the following regardless of which path you choose:
[list]
[*] Health upgrades
[*] Damage upgrades
[*] Relics
[*] Souls
[*] Void charges
[/list]
[h3]So what are the 3 exciting New Game+ paths you can choose from?[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899313/ab449f1d8eb9c96792a1887667ecb0a88a093993.png[/img]

[b]The Reborn[/b]

For those of you who like a major combat challenge, the Reborn path might be the choice for you. On this path, enemy damage and enemy health have been increased, so you better be ready for a fight!

[b]The Harbinger[/b]

If you’re a connoisseur of fine Relics, then the Harbinger might be the right path for you. On this path, enemy damage is increased and your regular attack damage is greatly reduced, but you have access to unlimited Void Charges so you can take full advantage of your Relic abilities at any time!

[b]The Undone[/b]

This path is for those Simulacrums who love a lot of risk with their reward. On this path, death itself becomes a weapon. You permanently lose 1 health bar per death and you cannot regain health outside of dying, but your regular attack damage is increased every time you die. On top of that, enemy damage is increased, so you’ll need to carefully consider every hit you take and die tactically for the greatest advantage. 

If you revert your New Game+ save file on the Undone path or start a new path after finishing the Undone, the health penalty and damage increase will be reset.

Once a path has been chosen, you must complete that path and defeat [spoiler]the Weeper[/spoiler] before you can move on to another path using that save file. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899313/3e9d2c1b93804ac9c45c9a38d4b41738227e5658.png[/img]

Please note that you can revert your New Game+ save back to a main game save, but the following conditions will apply:
[list]
[*] Reverting will restore the save file back to the exact point just before it was converted into a New Game+ file;
[*] Reverting will erase all New Game+ progress made on that save file;
[*] Once a New Game+ save file has been reverted back to a main game save file, it cannot be undone;
[*] Reversion works in layers. For example, if you’ve completed all three New Game+ modes on one save file, you’ll need to revert three times in order to return to the normal game mode. 
[/list]
[h3]Alongside the three New Game+ paths, we’ve also added Hardcore Mode to the game for any Simulacrum who yearns for an extra challenge, regardless of whether they’ve completed the game or not.[/h3]

[b]Hardcore Mode[/b]

When creating a new save, players can select the “Hardcore” option instead of the “Normal” option to enter Hardcore Mode without needing to have completed the game first. Please note that this cannot be changed once the save file has been created and you will not be able to revert to Normal difficulty on a Hardcore save file.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899313/f5fbb66a240f03e4ee5064514db52678b9ef9180.png[/img]

In Hardcore Mode, death is permanent and the save file is deleted upon death. It is important to note that, if you complete the game in Hardcore Mode and want to convert your save file into a New Game+ save file, the New Game+ save file will also be in Hardcore Mode.

[b]Please Note:[/b] With the addition of New Game+, we have had to change the way save files work. Once you update your build, all of your save files will be converted to this new system. Save files from this version are not compatible with earlier versions of the game so, if you revert to an older build of the game, you will no longer be able to access your save files. If you for any reason need to access your old file, a copy of it can be found here:

C:\Users\windowsuser\AppData\LocalLow\Powersnake\Voidwrought

Along with all of this new content, we’ve added four new achievements for you to unlock:
[list]
[*] [b]Hardcore[/b] - Beat the game on Hardcore Mode
[*] [b]The Reborn[/b] - Survived the path of the Reborn
[*] [b]The Harbinger[/b] - Survived the path of the Harbinger
[*] [b]The Undone[/b] - Survived the path of the Undone
[/list]

We’ve also included the following bug fixes in this update:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the player dying and killing the Prince simultaneously.
[*] Wandering Fossil enemies no longer stick to the walls on death. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899313/e5fb48c1f80e60e3a71c845fe66db5ccb8280a13.png[/img]

[h3]To celebrate the release of New Game+, we’ve decided to run our first ever speedrunning competition! Follow the link [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2014550/view/585007881273737229][b]here[/b][/url] to find out more about how to enter.[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2014550/Voidwrought/

[h3]Want to share your tips and tricks for tackling New Game+ with the Voidwrought community?

Then join our Discord and follow us on social media at @VoidwroughtGame![/h3]

[url=https://bit.ly/VoidwroughtDiscord][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899313/6f7c45fcb0573270ba8c14f52306d184fbc9ed10.gif[/img][/url]


[url=https://bit.ly/VoidwroughtFB][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250025/bb7e23a1085b28d25df050902e1e02b960917525.png[/img][/url][url=https://bit.ly/VoidwroughtTwitter][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250025/53a9f2fcd1bf24f4e1735dbc90b248bd39572da1.png[/img][/url][url=https://bit.ly/VoidwroughtInsta][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250025/1e551f92a20d174c14f449ebd6ef769c2f8de0af.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Patch #4: More Quality of Life Changes and Balancing
notes.content:
[h3]The Relics strewn throughout The Gray City have lain covered in dust for many hundreds of years, so we’ve decided to give them a good polish!

In this latest patch (Build 1.0.16), we’ve implemented a bit more balancing, particularly related to the Relics, some quality of life changes, and even more bug fixes.

Read on to find out more about whether your favorite Relic has been given an upgrade.[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2014550/Voidwrought/

When it comes to combat balancing, we’ve made the following changes:

[list]
[*] Lowered the HP of the following bosses: the Astronomer, the Pustulant Prince, and The Weeper.
[*] Tweaked the attack cooldowns of the following bosses: the Astronomer, the Pustulant Prince, and The Weeper.
[*] Tweaked the AoE hurtbox of the Pustulant Prince so it deactivates faster.
[*] Increased the HP of phase 2 during the Myrmidon encounter.
[*] Lowered the HP of the following common enemies: Black Wasp, Slugsac, and Carver.
[*] Increased drops for most bosses;
[*] Increased the HP of common enemies in the Obsidian Observatory.
[/list]
We’ve adjusted the following Relics and Souls to increase their damage. Some of these Relics will also scale with the player by adding a percentage of the player’s damage to their base damage:

[list]
[*] Astronomer’s Band
[*] Chakram
[*] Spectral Blade
[*] The Chained
[*] Crystalline Lens
[*] The Godseye
[*] Sky-shard
[*] Condensed Light
[*] Living Talon
[*] Censer of Ta-Hun
[*] Jazier the Pompous
[*] Volatile Jar
[*] The Servant
[*] The Forgotten Warrior
[*] Idol of So-Venat
[*] Serrated Gland
[*] The Legion
[*] Spectral Axe
[*] Mutated Gastropod
[/list]
Alongside the balancing changes, we’ve made a few of level design changes and some quality of life changes:

[list]
[*] The Vault in the Court has been moved to The Deep Bazaar.
[*] The Ancient Cipher in Mirrorways has been moved to the room behind The Skychild.
[*] The Salt Shard in the room behind the Skychild has been moved to the Mirrorways.
[*] Two resource nodes have been added in the Mirrorways.
[*] Added a Relic Fragment at the beginning of the path leading to the Skychild.
[*] Removed the Archaic Ward blocking the way up to the Skychild.
[*] Swapped positions of the location indicators for The Grand Bazaar and The Deep Bazaar in the Translocation Room.
[/list]
Last but not least, the following bug fixes are also included in this patch:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the incorrect button prompt to breach is displayed during the breaching animation for the possession mechanism in the Gardens.
[*] Fixed a small map issue at the “lamp puzzle” in the Court.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player character would play the wrong animation for a brief moment after defeating multiple bosses.
[*] Fixed an issue where the camera shake effect would play with the setting set to 0.
[/list]
[h3]Thank you so much once again to everyone who has helped us by providing their feedback and bug reports!

If you do encounter any other bugs or would like to give feedback on your experience of Voidwrought so far, we’d love to hear from you either in our Steam Forum or on Discord.[/h3]

notes.title: Patch #3: Our First Major Quality of Life and Balancing Patch
notes.content:
[h3]While The Gray City has always been divided between the weak and the strong, the balance must be delicately maintained…

Thanks to your feedback, we’ve decided to implement some major quality of life changes and boss fight balancing as part of our third patch (Build 1.0.12), along with lots of bug fixes!

Read on to find out more about who has been empowered, and who has been enfeebled.[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2014550/Voidwrought/


[h3]We’ve made the following major quality of life changes based on community feedback:[/h3]

[list]
[*] The Explorer Soul: If equipped, The Explorer will now “ping” when the player enters a room with an undiscovered secret. The Explorer will also start to ping when the player gets close enough to an undiscovered secret, and the frequency will slightly increase once the player moves closer. The ping consists of VFX, SFX, and controller vibration.
[*] The Shunned Library in the Shrine has been updated with a tracker for the amount of Anamnestic Recollections turned in to Ose the Archaeologist, as well as an indicator for how many are left.
[*] Whispering Stones are now tracked under Regions in the Compendium.
[*] The Vizier: A memory of the Vizier will appear even after the Vizier has met her demise, allowing the player to talk to her and complete quests.
[*] Dropped Health shard pickups are now more visible.
[/list]

[h3]Alongside these quality of life changes, we’ve also made the following balancing changes to combat in Voidwrought:


[b]General Combat[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Player invulnerability time upon getting hit has been reduced. 
[/list]
[h3][b]Boss Fights[/b][/h3]


[b]The Council [/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the chase duration of the third phase.
[*] The third phase will drop a health pickup when defeated.
[*] Lowered the HP for each head/phase.
[/list]
[b]The Eternal Engine[/b]
[list]
[*] Lowered the amount of adds for each wave.
[*] Removed the Copter from the enemy roster.
[*] Boss downtime increased.
[/list]
[b]The Skychild[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced most cooldowns.
[*] Increased Projectile Speed.
[*] Increased Projectile Targeting Speed.
[*] Room Sweeper and AoE now push the player away.
[*] Slight HP increase.
[/list]
[b]The Absolute Indexer[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced most cooldowns.
[*] Speed of the Laser Pincer attack and Laser Sweeper attack increased.
[*] Slight HP increase.
[/list]
[b]The Astronomer[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced most cooldowns.
[*] The possible number of active bounce projectiles increases during the fight, so they will stack over time.
[*] Some changes in the behavior.
[*] Slight HP increase.
[/list]
[b]Uut the Screamer[/b]
[list]
[*] Room Sweeper attacks now greatly push the player back.
[*] When damaging the boss for the first time, a sneaky horde of Wights will appear to the right.
[*] Slight HP increase.
[/list]
[b]The Fermented[/b]
[list]
[*] The Fermented now checks the player’s position and will act accordingly. 
[*] Telegraph VFX added to the puke attack.
[*] Attack cooldown after charge added.
[*] Fermented will always charge the first thing it does.
[*] More refined hurt and hitboxes were added to better match the charge and projectile telegraph animations.
[*] Slight HP increase.
[/list]
[b]The Font[/b]
[list]
[*] Tsunami hurtboxes are better defined and deactivate quicker.
[*] Most of the animation wind-ups and wind-downs are quicker.
[*] Phase thresholds adjusted.
[*] Slight HP increase.
[/list]
[b]The Pustulant Prince[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced most cooldowns.
[*] Increased movement speed.
[*] Increased movement speed of the projectile.
[*] Added AoE on boss stomp.
[*] Slight HP increase.
[/list]
[b]The Weeper[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced most cooldowns.
[*] Projectile speed increased.
[*] Room Sweeper speed increased.
[*] Instead of the prison spawning around the eye when staggered, it will now trigger an AoE.
[*] Slight HP increase.
[/list]
[b]The First[/b]
[list]
[*] Burning platform damage increased. 
[*] Homing projectile damage increased. 
[*] HP increased.
[/list]

[h3]Below, you’ll also find a list of all of the smaller quality of life changes, balancing, and bug fixes we’ve added into our third patch:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Adjusted drops for most resource nodes across the game.
[*] Certain Ancient Ciphers (Vault Keys) have been removed from rooms in: the Abandoned Expedition - Exchanged for Relic Fragment; the Commons - Exchanged for Divine Remnant; The Court - Exchanged for Divine Remnant; and The Gardens - Exchanged for Ichor Resource node and moved to The Grand Bazaar.
[*] The Gilded Emporium will now buy Ancient Ciphers if all Vaults have been opened and if there is a surplus of Ancient Ciphers in the player’s inventory
[*] Added a cutscene event for The Lost when it hatches.
[*] The Servant will now take The Lost’s place in the Soul Inventory when they swap (instead of leaving a blank slot).
[*] The Star Soul: Decreased projectile lifetime and greatly increased the size of the hurtbox. 
[*] Shrine Keeper: The Keeper will now also comment on the Prince if it’s the last boss that’s been defeated by the player.
[*] Time-lost Scholar enemy VFX and SFX improvements.
[*] Mutilant enemy VFX and SFX improvements.
[*] Alchemist enemy VFX and SFX improvements.
[*] The Mutated Gastropod relic has received VFX and SFX improvements, and can now also light up dark areas.
[*] The Serrated Gland relic has received VFX and SFX improvements.
[*] The Warp-Hook relic’s safety distance to walls has been increased slightly.
[*] The Warp-Hook relic has received VFX and SFX improvements.
[*] The Star, Forgotten Warrior, The Attendant, The Living Blade, The Servant, and The Legion souls have received VFX and SFX improvements.
[*] So-Venat now awakens if the player moves close without having to reload or reenter the Shrine.
[*]The Endless Kaleidoscope is now gained from the Grand Artificer instead of Qagat the Burdened
[*] Polished the Wrappings of Namun Relic.
[*] Fixed an issue where some players would get stuck in The Court due to a certain set of Simulacra. 
[*] Fixed an issue with the Assassin enemy disappearing through the floor.
[*] Fixed player character appearing stuck for a moment on entering some rooms. 
[*] Players can no longer simply slide to reach the Dash Simulacrum entrance. 
[*] Fixed blacked out areas in Slither passages.
[*] Players can no longer traverse below salt vats without The Impure Soul equipped. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the player disappeared after using slither between certain rooms.  
[*] Potential fix for disappearing saves. Due to the very rare occurrence of this bug, it has been hard to diagnose, so if it persists we will keep investigating.
[/list]

[h3]Thank you once again to all of our players for providing us with so much feedback and reporting the bugs that you’ve found so far!

If you do encounter any other bugs or would like to give feedback on your experience of Voidwrought so far, we’d love to hear from you either in our Steam Forum or on Discord.[/h3]

notes.title: Patch #2: More Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[h3]You may have thought our bug excavation of The Gray City was over…

And you’d be wrong!

Our second smaller patch includes even more bug fixes and some quality of life changes for you to enjoy.[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2014550/Voidwrought/


Here’s a list of the bug fixes and quality of life changes included in Build 1.0.7:

[list]
[*] Ose Softlock Failsafe: Loading a save with the Ose softlock will put the player in the Shrine
[*] Ose Softlock Failsafe: Ose won’t save the player’s position anymore
[*] Vaults won’t save the player’s position anymore
[*] Removed Unstable Nuclei “gate” after the Fermented boss to prevent possible softlocks
[*] A hitbox of a secret in the Gardens now deactivates as it should
[*] Set correct button prompts for the gate to the Court in the Commons.
[*] Room before the Prince modified to prevent the player becoming stuck in the pit when not having certain Simulacra
[*] Void Step Targets are now faintly indicated even when obscured or hidden within secret areas
[*] The extra health slots provided by the Slave soul are now refilled from all healing sources
[*] Relic Containers now spawn after the North Encounter in the Abandoned Expedition and after the Alchemist Miniboss to prevent rare cases of rewards being missed
[/list]

Thank you once again to all of our players for your detailed bug reports!

If you do encounter any other bugs or would like to give feedback on your experience of Voidwrought so far, we’d love to hear from you either in our Steam Forum or on Discord.

notes.title: Patch #1: Two New Languages Added and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[h3]The Gray City may be plagued by a myriad of dark and twisted creatures, but there's one nefarious beast that we hope to never see...

Bugs 🐞[/h3]

That's why we'd like to thank all of the players who have helped us by submitting bug reports so that we can hunt down and squash as many bugs as possible!

Before we get into the bug fixes though, we’re excited to announce that we’ve added Traditional Chinese and Hungarian to Voidwrought, or should we say…

我們加入了繁體中文！

A magyar nyelv mostantól elérhető!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2014550/Voidwrought/


In this patch, we've made significant changes to keyboard remapping, including:

[list]
[*] Fixed many instances of possible softlocking out of certain menus
[*] Blocked Esc and Enter keys from being assignable to prevent double mapping certain actions
[*] Fixed instances of certain actions being double mapped and not working in-game properly
[*] Fixed some instances of wrong or white glyphs being displayed
[*] Esc and Enter can be used in menus, however, a mapped button will be displayed
[/list]

On top of that, please find below a list of all of the other bug fixes and quality of life changes included in Build 1.0.6:

[list]
[*] Fixed softlocks and save issues caused by camera shake being set to 0
[*] Fixed issue where exiting some rooms upwards while using the Unstable Nuclei ability made the player fall out of bounds
[*] Added 1 Progenitor Flesh pickup to ensure enough are available
[*] The Gilded Emporium now sells Relic Fragments.
[*] Lone Crewman quest - Putrid Remains are now removed from the inventory upon quest completion
[*] It’s no longer possible to mistakenly delete save files when alt+tabbed out of the game on the save slot screen
[*] Improved visual cues for pogo attack tutorial at the beginning of the game
[*] Increased cooldowns for most relics for balancing and to prevent some problems when using the Astronomer Soul
[*] The save in the Shrine won’t save the player’s location anymore
[*] The Lost Soul now correctly consumes the Ichor when slotted instead of letting the Player keep it
[*] Art and audio polish on Subjugated and Emissary enemies
[*] Balanced one of the Lost Gardens encounters
[*] Impossible Anomaly Relic visual and audio polish
[*] Absolute Indexer boss - fix for getting stuck inside the walls when using pogo attack
[*] Fixed possibility of being locked out from a fight with Time-Lost Scholars
[*] Fixed Condensed Light relic beam being stuck in the Weeper fight
[*] Fixed wrong animation state on jumping through a door in Abandoned Expedition
[*] Fixed lasers not damaging the player character in Observatory
[*] Fixed the player respawning outside of one of the save rooms in the Grand Bazaar
[*] Fixed Eternal Engine boss not using his spike attack under certain conditions
[*] Fixed the main core texture being white under certain conditions during Eternal Engine boss fight
[*] Chronicler enemy should now react to Chrono Canister Relic
[*] Alchemist should not disappear mid-fight anymore
[/list]

[h3]Thank you once again to all of our players for your detailed bug reports!

If you do encounter any other bugs or would like to give feedback on your experience of Voidwrought so far, we’d love to hear from you either in our Steam Forum or on Discord.[/h3]

notes.title: From Cosmic Horrors to Legendary Myths: Introducing the Red Lotus Bundle
notes.content:
[h3]Ready for an adventure? 

We're excited to announce the Red Lotus Bundle, bringing together Voidwrought and Bo: Path of the Teal Lotus in one incredible package![/h3]

Explore beautifully hand-drawn worlds, weave your way through tense encounters with expert precision, and take on a myriad of other-worldly bosses from the exquisite to the grotesque in the Red Lotus Bundle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899313/92e2b12ab4cda08ebe96304915291c2b76813827.png[/img]

The [b]Red Lotus Bundle[/b] includes:

[b]Voidwrought[/b], a 2D action-platformer set in a hand-drawn world of cosmic horrors. You take on the role of the Simulacrum, a mysterious creature who has emerged from a cocoon with an unstoppable compulsion to collect Ichor, the blood of the gods. Explore the thawing ruins of the First Civilisation and strike down the gods that dwell there. Grow your powers, uncover ancient artifacts, and expand your shrine amid the wreckage.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2014550/Voidwrought/


[b]Bō: Path of the Teal Lotus[/b], a hand-drawn 2.5D action platformer inspired by Japanese folklore. Undertake a mystical journey as Bō, a celestial blossom (fox tentaihana) descended from the heavens to fulfill a mysterious ancient prophecy. Engage in acrobatic aerial combat, unlock powerful mystical abilities, and explore an interconnected world of myth as you seek to unravel the mysteries of your origin.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1614440/B_Path_of_the_Teal_Lotus/


If you already own Voidwrought or Bō: Path of the Teal Lotus, you’ll still be able to take advantage of the bundle. Instead of buying the full bundle, however, you’ll be given the option to complete the set and receive a 10% bundle discount on the other games, which will stack with any other discounts that are available on the games at the time (including our 20% launch discount!).

Want to let us know your thoughts on our new bundle?

Share your comments in our Discord and on social media at @VoidwroughtGame!
